title: Double cluster swapping for spin models: Pfaffian relations and sharpness
summary: We introduce and study a new geometric representation for general classical spin models. It consists of two coupled percolation configurations that are the joint FK (random cluster) representation of the Ginibre rotation of two independent copies of the spin model, and can be viewed as an extension of Sheffield's cluster swapping defined in the context of height functions.
